notices.short_title: Requirements Contracts for Public School Athletic League Insurance and Benefits
notices.description:
The New York City Public Schools (NYCPS), on behalf of the Public Schools Athletic League (PSAL), is establishing a requirements contract for a comprehensive student accident insurance program. To fulfill the ongoing needs of the league, PSAL is seeking proposals from qualified insurance carriers, agencies, brokers, or authorized third-party administrators ('Proposers'). The selected provider will deliver accident, medical, and dental insurance coverage, alongside related claims administration services, for eligible participants in PSAL-sponsored interscholastic athletic activities.

Notes:

  • The requested insurance program is strictly limited to eligible student athletes and authorized participants in approved, PSAL-sponsored interscholastic athletic activities.
  • The contract resulting from this Request for Proposals is a requirements-based contract wit…
notices.plain: The Department of Education is seeking proposals from insurers, brokers and claims administrators for a requirements contract to provide accident, medical and dental coverage for student athletes in Public Schools Athletic League activities, with responses due Dec. 9, 2026.

notices.description: MetroPlus is seeking qualified resellers capable of providing Rubrik an enterprise-wide backup solution that protects our virtual servers and Isilon file shares. There is also a ransomware detection piece that is utilized to inspect our backups for known malware. Support is required to keep our backup system and its components up to date and patched at the latest levels.
notices.plain: NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking competitive sealed bids, due Oct. 23, 2026, from qualified resellers to provide Rubrik's enterprise backup software for MetroPlus, covering virtual servers, Isilon file shares, ransomware malware scanning and ongoing support and patching.
